nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Truth Juice Gentle Glow Daily Cleanser

avis.texte: Excellent cleanser - gentle, effective, with a pleasant scent.
I have been using this for months now and it is my new morning go-to! Skin feels so smooth and looks radiant after use. Love the scent too!

I absolutely love the way this feels on my face. The smell is very pleasant, and I cannot get enough of this cleanser. I noticed a visible difference within a week of using it 2x daily. My skin feels softer, my complexion is brighter. Overall, love this cleanser and will be buying it again.
Use this daily in the shower and love it so much. It's a great cleanser & one of my fav olehenricksen products. Makes my skin feel so clean!

avis.titre: Not the best... skin doesnt feel clean and irritates
avis.texte: I dont have sensitive skin at all but this facewash burned a little bit. I usually love olehenriksen products so I'm sad I cant use this as a daily. Normally, I use my face washes AM/PM but something in this face wash irritates my skin and does not remove ALL makeup.
The very pleasant fragrant and the feeling of cleaned face after a long day before I go to bed Face is clearer too.

i was recommended this cleanser from the ulta employees after i noticed they no longer sell the indie lee brightening cleanser in store (what i used for years). after just two days of use, i noticed a big difference in my skin tone! it smells amazing and doesn't dry out my skin at all. i do have sensitive skin and did a patch test prior to use and had no issues. definitely recommend this cleanser!!

I'm picky and tend to switch around a lot, but I'm about to buy my third tube of this. I can use it and rinse right away or leave on for a few minutes for deeper exfoliation. I have sensitive skin, and no problems.

Leaves my skin feeling sooooo soft, and clean. It feels good when cleansing, not abrasive, and a little goes a long way. Its a creamy gel like texture, that leaves my skin feeling softer, cleaner, and looking brighter. I have used this for 4 months now, and still have some cleanser left. I am ordering another, right after I finish this review.

avis.titre: Would not recommend for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I was told this was the best cruelty free cleanser in store for sensitive skin (when asked for any alternatives, this was assured to me as the only option for sensitive skin). The cleanser is bright orange (not sure what kind of dyes used but that is usually a red flag for sensitive skin). I do not get acne, just a mild breakout from skin products that will disappear in a day once I discontinue use, but this product made my skin break out so bad within one day that not even pimple patches are making it go away days after discontinuing, which has never happened to me before. It may be totally fine for normal skin, but I strongly recommend avoiding this cleanser if you have sensitive skin.

I was nervous to use this on my acne prone, oily skin, especially with an already present breakout. At first, I couldn't tell if it was making the breakout worst or simply purging because of the PHA in it. Thankfully, it was the latter and my face has since cleared up. It's noticeably helped lessen my acne scars, has helped lessen any breakouts, and it makes my skin feel baby soft! Another plus is you don't need to apply much of it so one bottle is guaranteed to last me months. The only complaint I have about it is that it is incredibly hard to wash off and I can never tell if it's fully off or if some residue is still left over.

I love the smell of the product! It is my new go to facial cleanser. It washes the day away and removes all the makeup from my face without drying out my skin. It also gave my skin a boost of brightness
I stumbled upon this product 3 years ago and it was a game changer. I have sensitive skin and this cleanser has been amazing. Leaves the skin soft & feeling clean.

I was so excited to try this face wash but after just a week my skin went from great to horrible over night. I woke up to horrible red sore bumps on my checks an under eyes an my face was so dry . I wasn' sure if it was the face wash but was pretty sure due to that was the only new thing I was trying so I tried the face wash again after the red blemishes got smaller an it's been 2 weeks an the red blemishes are gone but my face is so drying. I have never experienced this issue in my life I have to keep facial oils on my face throughout the day to make my face feel hydrated it's terrible. So beware I never had really sensitive skin either just a few breakouts throughout the year.
i love this in the morning time, i pair it with the cold plunge toner and moisturizer

I combine this daily with the Lemonade scrub. This combo has been a game changer for my skin. For reference I struggle with acne scarring (seeing so much progress with this!) and dullness (my skin is glowing for the first time ever). Not to mention they both smell so good, makes you look forward to using everyday.

avis.titre: The only face wash I will use
avis.texte: I love how this makes my skin feel. No tightness and the perfect amount of suds

Perfect way to start the morning! The scent isn' to overpowering but still pleasant and refreshing. It has a very soft silky feel on the skin and doesn' leave my face feeling dried out. You literally only need a pea sized amount for this product for the price will last you a good amount of time.
This cleanser is great. It leaves my skin refreshed and glowing but never too dry. I wouldn' even consider using anything else.
Feels great and you only need a small amount which makes it go a long way!
I prefer the foaming cleanser that I used to purchase from you
I love how this face wash energizes my skin and helps me get ready for the day.

Bought this last week and used it two times before getting terrible swollen eyes, the whole area lookes dry and burned with shell-like eyelids. I had a presentation at work over Teams and people were shocked. This is 6 days ago and it's still there. Later I have read reveiws of many others experiencing the same. I am not sensitive or allergic to anything. This is my first make up/skin care review ever, but I find it important to warn other potential users

I don't think this is the best cleanser, sometimes after it, I will have to wash again. Much rather use another like Tula or Youth to the People. Not worth the money. Love the packaging, makes me feel happy in the morning but dont like the product

This is the best cleanser I have purchased. Although it is a bit more expensive than some of the other top brands, it is worth it. It leaves your skin both fresh and toned and smells amazing! I will definitely buy it again!
I have tried many cleansers but keep coming back to Ole. I never feel dried out after cleansing, only refreshed. And a little goes along way which is always good.
Love this product! Have been using it for years and will not change that!
Love the refreshing citrus smell. Cleans even waterproof mascara and eyeliner. Cleans without over drying skin.
Its an ok cleanser I dont break out and have acne. Exfoliation is also needed and then toner after you use this product.
My face always feels so clean and I love the smell of the product. I think the fine lines have diminished.
I was skeptical at first because the price but it lasts forever and it has cleared up my face entirely!
It is an incredible soap for the face, it leaves it very clean, without feeling stiff, it has a delicious smell and with just a little product it makes a lot of foam. I highly recommend it
I love this face cleaner. My face has never looked better in my 40s. Highly recommend!
I think this is ok. I feel it is a little drying like a lot of cleansers. I am going to switch back to an oil based cleanser, that is best for my skin. It does smell nice.
It dries the skin. My screen has been burnt and super dried and damaged by the new products that I have bought from Ole Henriksen.
Smooth velvety texture and wonderful orange scent of this cleanser glides on to gently cleanse and leaves your skin soft and smooth, not stripped.
I love this in the morning or for my second cleanse. It brightens and does not make my skin feel tight or dry.

I've always used these harsh, over promising cleansers that ripped my skin up and didn't do anything to clear my acne.. I found ole Henriksen a couple years ago and haven't looked back. I was skeptical about this cleanser being strong enough for what I needed.. and it blew me away! It smells so lovely, is light and creamy and gets rid of my makeup while clearing my skin. It's not harsh whatsoever, but definitely gets the job done! I've recommended to a few friends and they all agree, this is the cleanser!!
Smeels very citrus, foams up great, and washes off very clean

avis.titre: Only product I'll ever use for my face!!
avis.texte: I am a man and have always and I mean always suffered from flaky, dry skin for my entire life. I've tried just about any product always with the same consequences, more dry flaky, inflammed skin. My sister recommended this, and after 18 plus years of misery I found something that works! I have stopped experimenting with treatments, and I feel confident that this product wont dry up my skin.
I have noticed since using this product my skin looks so much better.

I got this as part of a set from Boots and have used for 3 months. I cannot believe the number of good reviews for this useless product. I only ever use this in the morning as you cannot trust it to remove any makeup in the evening. Even days I don't wear makeup and use this, my face does not feel clean. It doesn't remove even eyeshadow so don't even bother with waterproof makeup. Matte lipstick also stays behind. Additionally, my face doesn't feel hydrated after using this and doesn't provide that "Vitamin C glow" like other, cheaper products. The only pro about this is how amazing it smells, but when the product is terrible, why would I care?
This cleanser has the perfect consistency, not too thin, not too thick. It has a wonderful scent. The creamy formula glides on and does an excellent job of cleansing. This was a repurchase
I love this product. It smells and feels absolutely wonderful and works so well that I saw a difference after just one use. I highly recommend it.
Awesome purchase, loving it so far!! It makes my skin feel so smooth and silky.
So disappointed in this replacement for the original cleanser. It does not the a clean feeling on the face. I'll be asking for a refund.
I love how it cleanses, but also really enjoy the light fresh orange scent. It's a lovely cleanser.
Bring back the truth foaming cleanser. This one is so much heavier and not the same!

Smells wonderful and it foams up!! I guess I didn' even realize it until I mixed it with water lol. It leaves my face feeling clean and my skin soft, not tight. This will replace all my other face cleansers!
This product smells amazing and leaves your skin feeling so smooth without over drying! I love it!!!
Gentle but thorough cleansing; a single application is sufficient. Works well on my sensitive skin. Removes makeup & grime. Nice scent too.

I bought this cleanser in the small size just to check it out. I LOVE it. And I only need a little tiny amount to wash my face and neck. I use it day and night. I bought the smaller size and it has lasted me over 4 mos. My skin feels clean but not stripped. My face is somewhat sensitive and I've never had any issues with this. It's a great cleanser and a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: Makes my skin flake and red
avis.texte: The "brightening" of this cleanser is too powerful for my skin, compared to the previous Truth cleanser. My skin liked the previous version of the Truth cleanser. Now, I'm always red and flaking. I can't accept this product.

I love love this cleanser!! You don't have to use much for a very silky lather that cleans wonderfully but not drying or tight. And leaves no residue like you need to keep rinsing because you feel like there is still cleanser on your face. I love the smell too, it's really a great cleanser!

Light weight, not greasy, pleasant scent. This stuff gives me a nice glow and makes my skin look great. I just wish it was a little cheaper. However a little bit goes a long way so it should last a while.

I enjoy this cleanser.. It makes my skin feel fresh and clean in the morning and I feel as if it gets a lot of dirt off my face. The fragrance isn' all that but will I stop using it because of the smell.. no.
Absolute love this product. I use it everyday to clean my face and I see a big difference with my skin.

I have sensitive skin and I was looking for a new daily facial cleanser. This cleanser is amazing. It doesn't leave my skin dry or irritated. I haven't experienced any breakouts, rashes or flare-ups. It rinses clean without leaving a residue and it smells really nice.
Amazing cleanser! It cleanses your skin leaving it fresh and ready to go
Its a must buy, I love the gel like texture and the way my skin feels after.
THE TRUTH AND NOTHING BUT THE TRUTH! I LIVE FOR THIS SERUM AND I RECOMMEND TO EVERY PERSON I KNOW
The smell! The glow associated with it. I love the way my skin feels. I bought the whole set as a result of this cleanser and my skin looks amazing! Lighter and brighter.

avis.titre: Nothing special. The scent is nice. Not impresse.
avis.texte: Nothing special. Maybe I need to use I longer but after 3 weeks no change.

I think it's a great cleanser to try out! The only reason I give it 4 stars and not 5 is because that the wonderful scent goes away shortly after applying. Most likely just me being picky, but my other cleansers held their wonderful smell.
Absolutely love the smell of this! So far I'm loving this - no redness, dryness, or irritation from using this. I have combination acne prone skin and vitamin c washes tend to be my best frien.

This face wash is amazing! It actually removes waterproof mascara without having to scrub too hard in fact I don't have to use a washcloth to remove my makeup anymore this cleanser takes it all off with just using my hands to wash my face!
Love this cleanser , makes me feel refreshed and my fsvr feels so clean
I really like the cleanser the way it was formulated. It only takes a little bit and it makes my skin feel refreshed and clean when I am done.

The Truth Juice is just that...the truth! You don' need much to get a great lather. It also washes off easily, so you're not using a face cloth to drag the product all over your face and running the risk of damaging your skin. It smells wonderful, and leaves your face feeling cleansed. It's not squeaky clean, which is great. After washing, your face still feels hydrated. Great cleanser!
Great makeup remover. Leaves skin feeling soft and refreshed!

I decided I needed to redo my face regimen- In a week with Ole Henriksen I have seen a drastic change already. I couldn' pass up the lemon scrub which has a light scent like a lemon cupcake but not too sweet. In this same order I got the Glow2OH dark spot toner(amazing), TRUTH JUICE cleanser (LOVE... went back and ordered the whole truth line), find your balance oil cleanser( wonderful, I use this like a night time face wash), and Lastly but not least the Sheer transformation perfecting moisturizer ( love use this at night with the truth banana eye creme ANOTHER LOVE use morning and night). Sorry for the rant just so in love with everything I have gotten including the bonus gifts! Soooooo expect another order to get the TRUTH serum and the C rush brightening gel creme once the free travel size is done hahaha
Drying, yet makes my skin feel/become oily. Horrible replacement for Clean Truth Foaming Cleanser, please bring it back!
This wash is good although I'm still finishing the red tea foaming cleanser
Gentle cleanser, pleasant scent, otherwise I'm not impressedâ€"especially for the price.

avis.titre: Bring Back The Clean Truth Foaming Cleanser
avis.texte: This product is okay but I miss The Clean Truth Foaming Cleanser. I've used the foam cleanser for 6 years and it was the only product that got rid of my acne after 3 months and after so many painful appointments to the dermatologist.

I have recently just started using these products and I freaking love them. This cleanser is freaking awesome. I am in love with the smell. I look forward to washing my face just so I can use and smell this cleanser. Smell like orange. Will definitely buy again and again. Every since I have started using these products my face is brighter and smooth. Definitely recommend this cleanser.

I was so hoping my skin would love this. It goes on and off so beautifully but it is super drying on my face. It leaves it feeling tight and uncomfortable. I am of Irish descent, my skin is very fair, sensitive, blemish free, and still nearly wrinkle free at 58 years old. I ordered two more of the cleansers so will see if those work any better for me.

avis.titre: Good cleanser but wish it foamed
avis.texte: This product is underrated in reviews bc many people are rating it against the old foaming Truth cleanser instead of rating it as an individual product. I agree with the reviews requesting the return of Truth, but giving this product a 1 star is unfair to this product. This cleanser has a nice smell and works well. However, I do prefer foaming products as they seem to rinse better than this. But once I do get rinsed, my skin feels great.
I Purchased this as a gift for my granddaughter. She was really excited to get it and loves the product.

avis.titre: Okay but not good as old version
avis.texte: It's okay but not as good as the old foam cleanser. Don' understand why that one is no long sold.

avis.titre: Another Ole product that just doesn't fail
avis.texte: Love this cleanser, it works leaves skin very clean, fresh, smells really good,very fresh
Leaves your skin smelling citrusy fresh and super soft. Pairs lovely with the Vitamin C Bright Serum
This facial cleanser is wonderful. The smell is citrus and fruity, it lathers beautifully (especially with the complexion sponge), rinses clean with no residue and leaves my skin so sweetly soft.
Washes all my makeup away and still gives a subtle glow to my skin. I have had to purchase more often because now my entire family is hooked on my Ole Henriksen products.

avis.titre: Bring back the foaming cleanser please!
avis.texte: The foaming cleanser worked very well for me, plus once or twice a week I would combine it with the walnut exfoliator for a gentler exfoliating treatment. Please bring this product back!

I totally agree with other people, the foaming cleanser was excellent for my skin. This cleanser is not the best for me. I still believe you can have both, so you can serve your customers well, by attending to all our needs.
Although I did not purchase this new cleanser. I am disappointed that the foaming cleanser has been discontinued! It is the only thing that has worked for me all these years! PLEASE BRING IT BACK!!!!
